General information Reference 2026-229 Position Description Position Title Quality Coordinator H/F/D Mission Description
• Implementation, with a process-oriented approach, of Quality requirements, as well as support for the development and continuous improvement of processes
• Independent processing of variances, claims and ACAPs, and ongoing development of associated processes
• Planning, implementation and monitoring of internal audits and supplier audits
• Monitoring and monitoring the implementation of quality measures (corrective and preventive actions)
• Preparation of process optimizations based on audit activities, including initial analysis of improvement solutions
• Participation in product development to ensure that suppliers receive and comply with product specifications and that required compliance is ensured
• Support to the company in setting up and maintaining a process-oriented management system according to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 Profile
• Language knowledge:
• French: mother tongue
• German: advanced knowledge (B2)
• English: advanced knowledge (B2)
• Minimum training:
• Production mechanic CFCs or
• Federal patent in production
• Additional quality training, with at least one of the following certifications or trainings:
• CAS Quality Management – HEG Geneva (HES-SO)
• ARIAQ – SMI Coordinator (ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 / ISO 45001)
• ACTAGIS – Certification ISO training (PECB / ISACA)
• GS Switzerland – Integrated training ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 / ISO 45001
• France: Bachelor of Technology (B.U.T.) Quality – ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 Our offer
• A unique family business culture and sustainable, long-term business management
• Continuous development
• Attractive benefits, including our pension and social insurance plans
• Free parking or a contribution to public transport costs
• Attractive discounts on Victorinox products for employees Position location Company Victorinox Swiss Army SA Position location Switzerland Job location Delémont SUIVI PAR Head Joëlle Frésard Phone +41 32 421 39 04 •

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice d'informazione generale 2026-245 DESCRIZIONE DELL'AUTORITÀ Titolo del lavoro Responsabile innovazione prodotto 80-100% m/f/d Descrizione dei compiti
• Identificazione e sviluppo del potenziale di innovazione attraverso l'analisi di tendenze, tecnologie, mercati, materiali e modelli di business in tutte e quattro le categorie di prodotti.
• Iniziative di innovazione leader e di supporto – dall'ideazione e convalida al trasferimento al processo di creazione del valore.
• Traduzione dei risultati e dei risultati in Opportunity Briefs, concetti, esperimenti, progetti pilota e raccomandazioni chiare per l'azione.
• Valuta le opportunità di innovazione in termini di attrattiva (desiderabilità), di fattibilità, di fattibilità e di sostenibilità, comprese le esigenze del cliente, le potenzialità aziendali, la fattibilità tecnica e l'impatto sulla sostenibilità.
